options.name: onMessage
options.doc: Invoked once per message delivered on any topic given in the listener's subscriptions. The message parameter's declared type must be the connector's own mqtt:Message record as-is; unlike Kafka or RabbitMQ there is no narrower payload projection, so the handler decodes message.payload (byte[]) itself.

params.name: message
params.doc: The delivered message, carrying the raw payload bytes plus topic, QoS, and duplicate/retained flags.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for completing or responding to the message. Needed only when manualAcks is enabled (caller->complete()) or when replying to a request-style message published with a responseTopic (caller->respond()).

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when the underlying MQTT client loses its connection to the broker.

params.name: err
params.doc: The connection failure reported by the client.

options.name: onComplete
options.doc: Invoked once a message published through the caller, such as via caller->respond(), has completed delivery to the broker.

params.name: token
params.doc: Identifies the message ID and topic of the publish that completed delivery.
